# QR Code generator, Nayuki 1.8.0

Vendored unchanged from https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/cpp.
The MIT license and copyright notice are preserved at the top of both files.
The encoder runs locally; pairing invitations are never sent to a QR-image service.
